goal: Swift review: optionals, memory cycles, concurrency and secure storage.
use: Swift review: optionals, memory cycles, concurrency and secure storage. Use when asked to review a Swift project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. The package file, the Swift version and the lint configuration.
Check optionals. Flag force unwraps on external data.
Check memory. Flag closures that capture self strongly and create cycles.
Check concurrency. Flag shared state accessed off the main actor without care.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
